deliverables.change: migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot(): a pre-existing destination now skips only that file (continue) instead of aborting the whole legacy batch (return); colliding source and destination stay byte-for-byte unchanged.

loadEntriesFromFile(): the parsed final JSONL fragment (record without a trailing newline) is now pushed exactly once before the existing one-time newline repair, so reads retain the tail and re-reads stay idempotent.

Executable cross-module regression: real migrations.ts -> real utils/text.ts -> real core/session-manager.ts through .prale-eval/subject.mjs, with scratch inputs under .prale-eval/scratch removed in a finally block.
Cross-module explanation of both regressions, the minimal fixes, and the asserted behaviors.

claims.claim: A destination collision no longer stops later sessions from migrating; the colliding pair is left untouched.
claims.evidence: packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts:124-127 (continue), asserted by .prale-eval/regression.mjs 'collision keeps both files intact' and 'later sessions migrate after a collision'.

claims.claim: A valid final JSONL record without a newline is retained exactly once, then a single newline is appended, and re-reading is idempotent.
claims.evidence: packages/coding-agent/src/core/session-manager.ts:654-657 (finalEntry pushed before the existing appendFileSync repair), asserted by .prale-eval/regression.mjs 'migrated tail record is retained exactly once and repaired idempotently'.

claims.claim: Malformed lines are still skipped, ordered Unicode payloads survive multi-buffer reads, and non-session files are never rewritten.
claims.evidence: .prale-eval/regression.mjs checks 'malformed lines are skipped while the valid tail survives', 'newline-terminated files are untouched', 'multi-buffer Unicode stream retains ordered payloads and its tail', 'non-session files remain untouched'.

claims.claim: The regression script detects each original fault independently with an uncaught node:assert/strict AssertionError, not a crash, import error or timeout.
claims.evidence: Restoring only migrations.ts to 'if (existsSync(newPath)) return;' failed with 'the session after the collision must still be migrated out of the agent root'; restoring only session-manager.ts to the discarded finalEntry failed with 'migrated tail session: entries must be returned in file order exactly once' (actual ["gamma-session","gamma-1","gamma-2"], expected adds "gamma-3"). Both files were then restored to the repaired state.

validation.notes: Ran from the workspace root on Node v24.14.0; exit code 0 with 'regression: all checks passed' after the seven assertion groups (collision integrity, post-collision migration, migrated-tail retention/idempotent re-read, malformed-line skipping, terminated-file stability, multi-buffer Unicode ordering with a >1 MiB fixture, non-session file untouched). The script imports only .prale-eval/subject.mjs plus node builtins, uses fixed timestamps and promise-ordered steps (no real time, randomness, network or credentials), writes all inputs under .prale-eval/scratch and removes them in a finally block; the scratch directory is gone after the run. Mutation check performed locally: reverting either source file alone to its faulty baseline made the same script fail with an uncaught AssertionError from node:assert/strict (no crash/import error/timeout), and the repairs were restored before this run. The workspace has no installed node_modules, so the repository's vitest suites could not be executed; that is the only unavailable optional validation dependency, and it is recorded here instead of being relied upon.
